local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer()
for _, u in Players[me]:GetUnits():Members() do
    print("UID|" .. ((u:GetID() % 65536) + u:GetOwner() * 65536) .. "|" .. GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType)
end
print("---END---")

local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local gp = Game.GetGreatPeople()
if not gp:CanPatronizePerson(me, 76, 5) then
    local ind = GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[76]
    local name = ind and Locale.Lookup(ind.Name) or "unknown"
    local cost = gp:GetPatronizeCost(me, 76, 5)
    print("ERR:CANNOT_PATRONIZE|Cannot buy " .. name .. " (cost: " .. cost .. " faith)"); print("---END---"); return
end
local kParams = {}
kParams[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_PERSON_INDIVIDUAL_TYPE] = 76
kParams[PlayerOperations.PARAM_YIELD_TYPE] = 5
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(me, PlayerOperations.PATRONIZE_GREAT_PERSON, kParams)
local ind = GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[76]
local name = ind and Locale.Lookup(ind.Name) or "unknown"
local cost = gp:GetPatronizeCost(me, 76, 5)
print("OK:PATRONIZED|" .. name .. "|cost:" .. cost .. " faith")
print("---END---")
